count_note: The task brief listed 11 names for '10 total' pages: NIFRAUR85 and NIFRAUR86 are one page (dir NIFRAUR85-86, single year-range instrument NIFRAUR85/86), so 11 names = 10 pages, reconciled here.
note: Charter v4.2 item 4C orphan dispositions (2026-11-03). A baked stock page is an ORPHAN when its symbol is absent from nepse-chart/data/universe.json, because the symbol-page builder only regenerates in-universe symbols — so these pages kept the retired Debentures / Promoter Shares buckets after 4B. Each page below was decided on its own trade record, never on its name alone: every one traded in October 2026 and every debenture maturity in its name is a future BS year (or, for promoters, there is no maturity), so NONE is ended. No page was deleted silently and none is left stale. Regeneration was rejected as the repair: the builder renders a page with no verdicts entry as 'No recent price data', which would have wiped these pages' last-traded prices. Instead each page's sector displays were fixed to the master and its stale peer blocks were replaced by an honest peers-absent notice (marker 4C-ORPHAN-NOTICE in the page). When a symbol returns to the rebuilt universe, the next full build regenerates its page naturally and this entry should be retired. The CI invariant (tools/check-instrument-invariant.py) verifies every page below against the master and requires the notice marker on every listed dir.
